merged_nodes.title: Index of Industrial Production and related short-term industrial indicators (detailed)
merged_nodes.description: Detailed monthly indices of industrial production, shipments and inventories, with breakdowns by industry (including semiconductors and other key sectors). Extends the core Mining & Manufacturing Survey node.
merged_nodes._notes: Deepens the short-term activity coverage. Semiconductor and related electronics components are critical to Korea’s industrial cycle and export performance; these detailed series are closely watched by markets and policymakers.

live_edges_before.basis: Weights for the Index of Industrial Production (and related mining/manufacturing indicators) are derived from value-added data in the Economic Census (National Business Survey / Census of Establishments) and related annual surveys. Evidence: "Sources of weights: The weights for the base year were calculated for each industry and item based on the total added value of mining, manufacturing, electricity and gas in that year. The data used here was taken from the 2020 Economic Census, the 2020 Annual Mining and Manufacturing Survey and 2020 Gross Regional Domestic Product (GRDP)."
live_edges_before.evidence_quote: The data used here was taken from the 2020 Economic Census, the 2020 Annual Mining and Manufacturing Survey and 2020 Gross Regional Domestic Product (GRDP).

live_edges_before.basis: Industrial Production Index weights also incorporate Gross Regional Domestic Product (GRDP) value-added data for the base year and subsequent updates. Evidence: "The data used here was taken from the 2020 Economic Census, the 2020 Annual Mining and Manufacturing Survey and 2020 Gross Regional Domestic Product(GRDP). The weights after the base year have been calculated for each industry and item using the annual Mining and Manufacturing Survey and GRDP."
live_edges_before.evidence_quote: The weights after the base year have been calculated for each industry and item using the annual Mining and Manufacturing Survey and GRDP.
